items.title: 地方赛事全年目录与缓存补全

source.label: NAR 2026 年度目录
filters: 地方 G1／JpnI，排除指向 JRA 的中央赛事
caveats: 地方年度目录中有 13 场；这不是 13 场详细资料或赛前赔率全部齐备。
合并回放共 37 条使用了昨日中央缓存；本轮中央导航遭请求通道失败，源站状态未知。

preview.note: 展示 13 场目录中的 5 场，保留源名称及实际链接阶段。

methods.code: def nar_annual_events(content, url): """NAR's annual list includes local races and links to two JRA G1s. Keep only source-published local GI/JpnI cards; JRA is collected separately. """ year_match = re.search(r'/(20\d\d)/racelist/', urlparse(url).path) if not year_match: raise ValueError('No source year in annual directory URL') year = int(year_match[1]) titles = Page(content).text title = titles[0] if titles else '' if not re.search(rf'\b{year}年', title): raise ValueError('Annual document year does not match its URL') events = [] central_courses = {'札幌', '函館', '福島', '新潟', '東京', '中山', '中京', '京都', '阪神', '小倉'} for block in re.findall(r']*class="[^"]*\bjs-item\b[^"]*"[^>]*>(.*?)', content, re.S): heading = re.search(r']*class="([^"]+)"[^>]*>(.*?)', block, re.S) if not heading: continue grades = set(heading[1].split()) & {'g1', 'jpn1'} if not grades: continue page = Page(block) text = ' '.join(page.text) name = ' '.join(Page(heading[2]).text) day = re.match(r'(\d+)月(\d+)日', text) if not name or not day: raise ValueError('Incomplete annual race identity/date') course = re.search(r'([^\s]+)\s+[左右]\d+m', text) links = [a for a in page.anchors if a['href']] if len(links) > 1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous annual race link; preserve cache') link = links[0] if links else None absolute = urljoin(url, link['href']) if link else None # Future central G1 cards can have their anchor commented out. # Classify those by the published central venue, not by a race name. if absolute and urlparse(absolute).hostname == 'www.jra.go.jp': continue if not absolute and 'g1' in grades and course and course[1] in central_courses: continue if absolute and (urlparse(absolute).hostname != 'www.keiba.go.jp' or not absolute.endswith(('/racecard.html', '/introduction.html'))): raise ValueError('Unexpected annual race path') when = date(year, int(day[1]), int(day[2])).isoformat() time = re.search(r'(\d{1,2}:\d{2})発走', text) distance = re.search(r'([左右])(\d+)m', text) events.append({'key': f'nar:{year}:{name}', 'source': 'nar', 'year': year, 'name': name, 'grade': 'G1' if 'g1' in grades else 'JpnI', 'date': when, 'scheduled_start_at': f'{when}T{time[1].zfill(5)}:00+09:00' if time else None, 'start_time_provisional': '発走予定' in text if time else None, 'distance_m': int(distance[2]) if distance else None, 'schedule_text_raw': text, 'detail_url': absolute, 'detail_link_status': ('introduction' if absolute.endswith('/introduction.html') else 'racecard') if absolute else 'not_published', 'parent_url': url, 'href': link['href'] if link else None}) if not events: raise ValueError('No supported local GI/JpnI annual records') if len({r['key'] for r in events}) != len(events): raise ValueError('Duplicate annual race identities') return events

items.title: 南部杯出马、正式赛果与最终单胜

source.label: NAR 南部杯官方资料
filters: 按马号匹配出马表、赛果及独立单胜页
caveats: 三份资料的 11 匹马名和最终 Win 一致；本次赛后读取不证明比赛日前的报价可用。
JBC 未来页仍为出走予定，不能提升为正式枠顺或可购买报价。

evidenceFlow.title: 逐马核对
evidenceFlow.body: 出马表嵌套 tr 不作为匹数；11 个唯一马号的名称和 Win 与赛果、赔率页逐项一致，赔率页明确标为最終。

items.title: 马匹五场战绩可读，历史详情仍待定位

source.label: NAR 冠军马匹资料
filters: 马匹由正式赛果冠军及实际出马表链接选择
只取 2026-10-12 之前的五次出赛
caveats: 本样本此前五场均为中央比赛，NAR 马匹页没有提供这五场详情链接或逐场 Win。
